_comment: Community-established FT4/FT8 calling frequencies for amateur satellites.
_comment2: These are NOT in the SATNOGS database. Source: JH1NHK @JH1NHK (https://x.com/JH1NHK/status/1882598594924212321)
_comment3: Format: Rx=downlink, Tx=uplink. Frequencies may change as community conventions evolve. Last reviewed: 2026-06-01.

description: FT4 Calling — community standard (V/U inverting transponder)
notes: Community FT4 calling frequency within the V/U inverting transponder passband. Rx 435.612 / Tx 145.993. Not in SATNOGS. Ref: JH1NHK https://x.com/JH1NHK/status/1882598594924212321

description: FT4 Calling — community standard (U/V inverting transponder)
notes: Community FT4 calling frequency within the U/V inverting transponder passband. Rx 145.857 / Tx 435.118. Not in SATNOGS. Ref: JH1NHK https://x.com/JH1NHK/status/1882598594924212321. invert=true confirmed 2026-08-02 against SATNOGS' own 'U/V SSB Transponder' entry for this satellite (downlink mode=USB, uplink_mode=LSB) after a user report that FT4 mode selection set Sub (UL) to USB-D instead of LSB-D.
Community FT4 calling frequency. Rx 435.812 / Tx 145.938. Not in SATNOGS. Ref: JH1NHK https://x.com/JH1NHK/status/1882598594924212321

description: FT4 Calling — community standard (U/V inverting transponder)
notes: Community FT4 calling frequency, 2 kHz above the bottom edge of the U/V linear transponder passband — same offset confirmed against RS-44/JO-97/MO-122 (SATNOGS-registered passband UL 435.130-435.150 / DL 145.950-145.970 MHz, invert=true, uplink_mode=LSB). Rx 145.952 / Tx 435.148. Not in SATNOGS as a dedicated FT4 entry. Requested on GitHub Issue #16 (ei4gnb), 2026-08-08.

GMSK ASM+Golay digipeater rides at a fixed audio offset inside an SSB passband (GreenCube's own approach), not a standard FM/AFSK transponder. SATNOGS now lists the real NORAD 69912 row as 'Mode V/V Digipeater' (mode 'FSK AX.100 Mode 5'); this override corrects it to USB, Up=Down=145.875 MHz. Re-pointed from the provisional id 98272 to 69912 on 2026-09-06 (load_community_transmitters keys on uuid and updates norad_cat_id in place). 2026-07.
